answer: A Raft-style quorum lease makes each AI agent identity valid only while its leader holds a majority lease, so a zephyr of forged registrations cannot outrun a committed log. During a partition the minority side stops issuing identities until a dawn election re-establishes quorum, blocking split-brain sybils. A haven of honest majority thus costs an attacker a sustained majority of nodes plus lease-renewal latency, though a compromised leader can still mint identities until its lease expires.
